title: kv-cache: initialize per-stream views after buffer allocation
desc: Fixes the draft-mtp abort on Vulkan (#23737): k_stream/v_stream views were created before KV tensor allocation, leaving tensor->data NULL on backends that skip ggml_backend_view_init. 20-line guarded init after buffer allocation. Verified on gfx1151/RADV — CLI, server -np 4, /slots save-restore, tool calling, vision all pass; 31.8 t/s where stock aborts in 14 s.

title: Root cause analysis: draft-mtp acceptance collapse under concurrent load
desc: Traced deterministic NaN in speculative decoding to H2D input write racing the compute stream on HIP. Fixed with a synchronize before set_inputs. Independently verified by two contributors. Also resolves multi-slot corruption and #27579.
